calls.statement:
SELECT 
  SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold,
  s.store_name,
  p.category
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
WHERE s.store_name = 'Hyvinkää'
  AND p.category = 'Cleaning Products'
  AND f.sale_date BETWEEN '2026-08-31' AND '2026-09-27'
  AND s.store_id != 999
  AND p.category != 'ZZ Test'
GROUP BY s.store_name, p.category

SELECT DISTINCT store_name, store_id
FROM dim_store
WHERE is_current = TRUE
  AND store_id != 900
  AND store_id != 999
ORDER BY store_name
